turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

I can help you start a tattoo booking. Please tell me: 1) the design or idea you have in mind, 2) the approximate size, 3) where on the body you would like it, and 4) when you are available. A colleague will then take over the booking. I cannot give prices or dates myself.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your booking request to a colleague, who will take over from here. They will get back to you about price and dates. Your request: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available on weekday evenings.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given. Customer's order number and email not provided.
